The cache does not give a designation date, byway campaign, road construction history, grades, curves or drive time. The history paragraph concerns the older Southwest Trail and the K-4 corridor, not the origin of the byway designation.
The church and Wabaunsee pages disagree on the emigrant group size (about 70 versus nearly 100). Both figures are omitted. No present interior access is promised.

No substantive current claim was dropped for lack of cache support. The prior tagline’s suggestion that the church was named for rifles is clarified: the source says it was named after Henry Ward Beecher.
Lake Wabaunsee is kept below 90 words because its construction and wartime camp history are brief in the cache; no present recreation or access details are added.
